description: List Self.xyz attestations stored on a buy account. Useful before calling a KYC-gated endpoint to confirm the wallet already has a matching attestation (scope, minimum age, OFAC, etc.). This tool cannot create an attestation: the user creates one with `buy verify hosted --endpoint <receiver-url>` against a gateway-hosted receiver, or `buy verify serve --scope <scope> --min-age N --ofac` locally.

account.description: Account name. Defaults to the configured default account.

name: buy_verify_status
